page.overview:
Who is Obelisk Blue?

Obelisk Blue (オベリスク・ブルー Oberisuku Burū) is a location in Yu-Gi-Oh! GX. It is the highest-ranked dormitory at Duel Academy and is mostly made up of students who are wealthy, have influential connections, or have the highest grades and Dueling skills in their class.

The dorm is named after the Egyptian God Card, "Obelisk the Tormentor", which was previously owned by Seto Kaiba (who serves as the academy's owner) during the Battle City tournament in the Yu-Gi-Oh! anime. The dorm's superiority over the Slifer Red and Ra Yellow dorms, including the luxurious accommodations and the students being skilled and most arrogant Duelists, are among Kaiba's most defining traits.

Being the highest-ranked dormitory in Duel Academy, the Obelisk Blue dorm is designed to be luxurious. The dorm features a luxurious interior design, high-quality rooming, and finer food offered to the students who reside here. To enroll in Obelisk Blue from the onset, the student must not only have had high grades in the written and Duel examinations, but they also need to have been enrolled in the middle-school division of Duel Academy before attending the high-school division. Students who transfer directly to the high-school division are only allowed entry to Ra Yellow at the highest.

The dormitories are divided into separate sections based on gender, a trait unique to this dorm. Dr. Vellian Crowler is in charge of the boys' dorm, while Fonda Fontaine is in charge of the girls' dorm. With Obelisk Blue being the only dorm with separate housing for male and female students, there is some ambiguity as to whether the other dorms have any female students or not. The only exception to this is Blair Flannigan, who entered the Slifer Red dorms separately from the traditional entrance exams.
